_about: Sentences the plan is built from. {placeholders} are filled in by advisor.py.

hour_advice_default.limit: Keep outdoor time short and easy.

rule_floor_hour: GRAP advises against outdoor activity at this stage.
verdict_note: Set by the GRAP rules at Stage {stage}, not by the AQI alone.

window_title.worst: Best time for: {activity} (worst air, get off the road)

actions.not_allowed: Not allowed at this GRAP stage: {label}. Plan around it.
actions.advised_against: Skip or move indoors: {label} (GRAP citizen charter).
actions.no_clean_window: No clean window today. The least-bad time is {start} (AQI about {aqi}).
actions.break: Take your break {start}–{end}, when the air is worst, indoors if you can.
actions.mask_have: Wear your N95 outdoors; it only works if it fits tightly with no gaps.
actions.mask_advice: A well-fitted N95 cuts what you breathe in outdoors; cloth and surgical masks do little.
actions.windows: Keep windows shut at the worst hours and air rooms out at the cleanest one.
actions.watch_symptoms: Watch for cough, wheeze, chest tightness or breathlessness, and go indoors if they start.

suggestions.not_allowed: Restricted at the GRAP stage in force. The rule says what applies instead.
suggestions.advised_against: GRAP's citizen charter advises against this at this stage. Keep it indoors or skip it.
suggestions.too_poor: Even the cleanest time ({start}, AQI about {aqi}) is too poor. Keep it indoors.
suggestions.take_break_at: Take it from {start} instead, when the air is worst (AQI about {aqi}), and stay off the road.
suggestions.very_poor_movable: Air is very poor at this time. Move it indoors.
suggestions.very_poor_fixed: Air is very poor at this time. Keep it short and avoid busy roads.

stale.title: Older forecast
stale.text: The live forecast could not be reached, so this plan uses the last one, fetched {fetched} IST.

forecast.title: Forecast, not a sensor
forecast.text: Numbers come from the Open-Meteo air-quality model, not a ground station. Hourly AQI is an estimate, since CPCB defines AQI on 24-hour averages.

stage_estimate.title: The GRAP stage is our estimate
stage_estimate.text: It is worked out from the forecast. CAQM declares the official stage, so check its latest order before acting on a rule.

stage_declared.title: GRAP stage from CAQM
stage_declared.text: This is the stage CAQM declared, as entered by the Saans Compass team.

stage_official.title: What-if stage
stage_official.text: You picked Stage {stage} to see what changes. It may not be the real stage today.

limits.title: Your limits are our estimate
limits.text: The Go and Limit levels, breath dose and cigarette comparison are our own estimates, not official limits.

limits_profile.title: Your limits are our estimate
limits_profile.text: Your Go and Limit levels are {shift} AQI points lower because of: {reasons}. These, the breath dose and the cigarette comparison are our own estimates, not official limits.

uncovered.title: Not covered by GRAP
uncovered.text: Answers marked "Check the official order" are things the GRAP schedule does not cover.

medical.title: Not medical advice
medical.text: If you feel unwell, see a doctor. In an emergency, call 112.
